subject: Proposal: make demo two short blocks — CTO wants to join
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@NimbusAnalytics.com>, sara.hughes@nimbusanalytics.com
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: make demo two short blocks — CTO wants to join

Hi Daniel / Sara —

Thanks for confirming interest in a technical walkthrough. We had penciled in a 60–75 minute session on Tuesday, Aug 18 at 11:00 PT. Daniel, you mentioned Daniel (CTO) may want to join a portion of that meeting — thanks for the heads up.

To avoid trying to shoehorn two different audiences into one long session, would Nimbus be open to a two-block plan:

- Block A (30 min): Executive/architecture overview + strategic Q&A (CTO / VP level)
- Block B (45 min): Hands-on demo + integration questions (engineering + platform team)

We can schedule both blocks back-to-back, or split them across the same day with a short break. If the CTO can only make part of the window, we can keep Block A lean and record it.

Attached: demo deck v2 (shortened exec section) and a compact agenda you can share internally.

Would you prefer back-to-back on Aug 18 (11:00 / 11:35 PT) or two separate slots (exec at 11:00, deep dive at 14:00 PT)?

Thanks — I can adjust quickly.

Cheers,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (12MB stub), demo-agenda-compact.docx (43KB stub)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Hughes <sara.hughes@nimbusanalytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: make demo two short blocks — CTO wants to join

Kimberly —

Appreciate the flexibility. Yes — CTO (Daniel Park Sr.) would like to join the exec portion but he only has a 30–40 minute window around 11:15–11:50 PT on Aug 18 because of an investor briefing that morning. Our engineering lead can make the later slot.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can the executive block be kept to 25–30 minutes with a clear set of takeaways (SLA/cost/ops implications)?
- Can you include a short slide showing private deployment options and audit/trace capabilities?

If back-to-back works and you can compress Block A to 30, we prefer that. If you think the deep dive needs more breathing room, propose 11:15 exec + 14:00 deep dive.

Thanks — I’ll await your proposed schedule.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Director of Engineering (acting CTO for scheduling)
Nimbus Analytics
daniel.park@NimbusAnalytics.com

We can definitely compress the exec block to a tight 25–30 minute format focusing on the three things Daniel called out: cost/unit economics, private deployment controls (KMS/HSM / audit logs), and latency SLO examples. I’ll remove a couple of slides and add a single-slide callout for Private + Compliance.

Suggested schedule (all PT):
- Aug 18, 11:15–11:40 — Exec/CTO slice (recorded)
- Aug 18, 11:50–12:35 — Deep dive + Q&A (engineering)

Advantages: gives the CTO the slot he needs and leaves a 10–15 minute buffer for breaks/technical setup. If Nimbus prefers same-day but later deep dive, we can move the deep dive to 14:00.

I attached the trimmed deck (redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf) and a one-page exec summary. Kimberly — if this looks good, can you send updated invites? Marissa, looping you in as VP sponsor in case we want to offer alternate times.

Best,

Marissa / Soojin — FYI, we’ll lean on you for the 11:50 deep dive if the engineering questions go deep.

See you Tuesday — looking forward to it.
